meta.title: WorkGraph — Search the live job index
meta.description: Search the live job index. A match note is an estimate when a profile is available to compare.

states.pageStopped: The page stopped before it could finish. Refresh it to try again.
states.offline: You are offline. Saved changes wait on this device until the connection returns.
states.waitingFailed: Some waiting updates did not save
states.waitingFailedNext: Open the tracker and move the stage again.
states.sourceGap: Jobs from {source} did not load. The other sources are still listed.
states.emptyTitle: Applications you log will show up here
states.emptyReason: The tracker is empty because nothing has been logged on this account.
states.filterReason: Posted today is the filter hiding results.

tracker.movedDeviceNext: This saves when you are back online.
tracker.moveFailedNext: It is back in the previous stage.
tracker.quiet: No update has been recorded recently. Add a next step if you want one. The gap is in the record, not a judgement of you.
tracker.quietDays: No update has been recorded for {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}}. Add a next step if you want one. The gap is in the record, not a judgement of you.
tracker.rejected: This application is marked rejected. That records this outcome. It does not describe the rest of your search.
tracker.confirmMove: This moves {count, plural, one {# application} other {# applications}} to {stage}.
tracker.companyMissing: Add a company. The application needs one.
tracker.roleMissing: Add a role. The application needs one.
tracker.errorCount: {count, plural, one {# field needs a value.} other {# fields need a value.}}

contact.heading: Talk about a job search
contact.body: Have a question or feedback? A person reads this form. We aim to reply within two business days.
contact.sentNext: We aim to reply within two business days.
contact.failed: The message did not send. The connection failed. Try again.

jobs.emptyReason: Try a broader role or skill, or open a recent search.
jobs.languageHint: No results in your language. Try the same role or skill in English too.
jobs.errorReason: The jobs request did not finish. Your filters are unchanged. Try again.

hero.searchFailed: Jobs did not load. The search request failed. Try the search again.
hero.searchEmpty: No roles matched that search. Try a broader role or skill.

onboarding.resumeGap: A resume gives the match a profile to compare. Search still works without one.
onboarding.roleGap: A target role fills the search when you finish. You can add one on the target role step.
onboarding.locationGap: A location starts the feed nearer to you. You can add one on the location step.
onboarding.jobsFailed: Jobs did not load. The search request failed. You can still continue.
onboarding.roleMissing: Add a target role, or continue and search without one.

swipe.hint: Swipe right to move back. Swipe left to move forward. Undo is on the notice.

format.dateSample: Example date uses locale date formatting.
